message:
fix(apk): an X press refused while the capability was missing stays refused to its up; a sent press keeps its owed release (keepalive-r2 e r2, Codex apk_xfence r1 X1 X2)

The r1 fence read only the current capability: a down refused before the first Pong, then the X
Pong, let that press's up and the X bit of its moves through with no down before them (Codex
probe). ClientMouseXPressLedger (client_mouse_xbutton_fence.hpp) remembers per X button what
became of the press -- refused at the entry, dropped right before sending, or sent (release owed)
-- on both sides apart. A refused press is refused whole (up and held bit) until its up; the next
press is judged afresh. A sent press's release goes only while the host takes X: no exception to a
host without X, so a park cannot finish and ends by its own bound. The ledger lives under parkMu_
and is reset with the connection.

Test: client_session_xbutton_fence_test 43/43 x6 -- unknown->X, X->noX at sending then X again,
X->noX with an owed release (park not confirmed, session ends, wire X 0), reconnect, the ledger
alone. Mutants: entry forgets 3 FAIL, send forgets 2 FAIL, no reset 1 FAIL. The 21 targets that
compile the controller build; role_park 13/13, prelogin_select 60/60, others as reported.
